question: The 'tragedy of the commons' refers to a situation in which:
A: Government regulation of a shared resource leads to its overuse
B: Individuals acting in their own self-interest deplete a shared, open-access resource, even though this harms the group as a whole
C: Private ownership of resources always leads to conservation
D: Resources owned collectively by a community are automatically protected from overuse

B: Total catch rose while the fish population fell, then both catch and population collapsed as the resource was depleted, illustrating the tragedy of the commons.
C: Fish population increased while catch declined, showing effective self-regulation by fishers.
D: Catch and population remained constant throughout the 30 years.
